card.name: Body weight units in dosing
card.fires_on: The word for body weight (weight, pound, lb, Weighing) in dose instructions, especially right after 'per' or a slash. Often in pediatric or weight-based dosing.

modes.label: Pound units after per
modes.description: The unit lb or pound after 'per' or '/' in a per-body-weight dose.
modes.example: The usual pediatric dosage is 0.5 mg to 1 mg per<< pound>> (1 to 2 mg/kg)

modes.label: Weight as dosing basis
